analysis:
The PR only adds one documentation row to docs/reference/configuration.md (head line 329) for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES. This is a deadline-admission estimator rollback switch (per-batch decode charging, anchored isolated-prefill rate, newest-observation freshness), default on, with 0/false/off/no disabling it, and it is forwarded to the launchd provider job. The patch contains no code or control changes, so no authorization, attestation, encryption or data-exposure behavior changes in this PR.

Security consideration: an operator, who is already within the ADV-001 environment-control capability, could disable the corrections and fall back to the previous estimators. That affects scheduling and admission accuracy (availability/performance, adjacent to T-010 and T-029), not confidentiality or integrity of consumer prompts. It cannot bypass App Attest serving authorization (A-016, TB-011), attestation (TB-009) or E2E encryption (TB-002). The documentation does not claim any security property.

Unverified contract: I could not see the referenced AdmissionRateEstimators.swift or the LaunchAgent passthrough list, so the claims that the variable is forwarded and how it is parsed are unverified. This is a documentation accuracy question only, not a finding. The existing T-041 prefix-cache material is untouched. Because the PR changes only documentation, no threat-model update is needed beyond optionally confirming the passthrough claim in a code pass.
